title: Layout Plugin Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit
description: Retrofit the already-V1-migrated 📏️layout plugin (at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📏️layout/) to the newly-amended "Shape V2" tree-purity rule from master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE (see its TEMPLATE.md's Shape V2 lead section and §14 retrofit recipe). Purely mechanical: move the owner-root 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs (update [lib] path + prefix every #[path] with ../../), fold sibling variant files (🦀️canvas.rs, 🦀️config.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs, 🦀️wasm.rs, ⚙️engine/🦀️scene.rs) into their own <folder>/🦀️component.rs, and relocate the nested 🗿️artifacts/📏️layout/🛂️manifest.json to the owner root. No logic changes, no wire-format risk. Zero test-count drift is the correctness bar. Exclusive ownership of ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📏️layout/** for this ticket.
summary: Retrofitted the already-V1-migrated 📏️layout plugin to Shape V2 tree purity (TEMPLATE.md §14). Moved owner-root 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, updated [lib] path to "📦️lib.rs", and prefixed every #[path] leaf with ../../. Folded 5 sibling variant files into their own component folders: 🦀️canvas.rs→🖼️canvas/🦀️component.rs, 🦀️config.rs→🧮️config/🦀️component.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs→🗣️terminology/🦀️component.rs, 🦀️wasm.rs→🌉️wasm/🦀️component.rs, ⚙️engine/🦀️scene.rs→⚙️engine/🎬️scene/🦀️component.rs (folder names match established repo convention, e.g. 💠️lowpoly/🖍️draw). Relocated nested 🗿️artifacts/📏️layout/🛂️manifest.json to the owner root. Fixed one real bug surfaced by the move: scene.rs's include_bytes! for MapLabelSans.ttf is resolved relative to the file's own disk location (not via #[path]), so moving it one folder deeper required one more ../ (5→6 levels); confirmed via compiler diagnostic and corrected. All other moved files verified byte-identical to git HEAD via diff. Verified in isolation via a temporary [workspace] overlay in the crate's own Cargo.toml (root cargo metadata is blocked repo-wide by an unrelated in-flight 📕️norm dangling-manifest issue) — cargo check clean, cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2 clean, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean (all warnings shown belong to pre-existing dependency crates store-sync/semio-framework-plugin, none in semio-s-plugin-layout), cargo test --lib 116/116 passing (exact match to the V1 baseline, zero drift). Overlay and its nested target/Cargo.lock deleted before handoff. Confirmed via find: tree now contains nothing but component.rs/📦️packages/plain folders below the owner root. No AGENTS.md/README.md collision (single owner-root AGENTS.md, untouched). No external repo references to the old owner-root 📦️lib.rs path. Registrar handoff: none needed — root Cargo.toml's member line and [lib] path were already pointing at 📦️packages/🦀️rust from the prior V1 migration; this was a pure internal reshape.
